items.title: Wholesale prices flatten out in July and inflation eases
items.content: Wholesale prices were flat in July and inflation pressures in the guts of the economy also eased, adding to recent evidence of a slowdown in the rising cost of living.

items.title: Bill Ackman once exited his Netflix stake in a huff. He’s buying the streaming giant again, as well as these five stocks.
items.content: Netflix is once again an apple in Bill Ackman’s eye, as the streamer was among six stocks Pershing Square added in the last six months.

items.title: The AI boom is not just driving stocks — it’s also moving the foreign-exchange market
items.content: Interest-rate differentials, inflation trends and trade balances are usually thought of as drivers of foreign-exchange movement — but increasingly, the drivers in the currency market are companies looking to expand their offerings in artificial intelligence.

items.title: Social Security recipients will get more money next year. Here’s how much the COLA may boost benefits.
items.content: Social Security’s cost-of-living adjustment could be as much as 3.6% in 2027.

items.title: If you can answer this one question, you’ll never worry about money again
items.content: YNAB founder Jesse Mecham’s new book has a simple system to end the paycheck-to-paycheck struggle.

items.title: Nvidia, Intel, Google: Wall Street is partying like it’s 1999
items.content: The signs are all around that Wall Street is back in that dangerous atmosphere of giddy euphoria that those with long memories will remember from the infamous dot-com bubble of the late 1990s.

items.title: We live on a farm and have $2.2 million saved for retirement. We’re ready to retire abroad. Can we afford it?
items.content: ”We don’t live lavishly, and sometimes we both think maybe we could upgrade a few things.”

items.title: Lenovo profits soar past expectations on AI computers, servers and services
items.content: Lenovo Group on Thursday became the latest company in the build-out of artificial intelligence to report soaring profits that caught investors by surprise.

items.title: Flying first class is getting cheaper — if you don’t mind giving up some perks
items.content: ‘Basic first class’ is here as airlines move to create multiple tiers of their most premium seats.

items.title: Cisco’s stock falls on margin concerns. Here’s what Wall Street analysts are saying.
items.content: Analysts say a focus on the artificial-intelligence ‘supercycle’ could pressure gross margins.
